``` python
def euclidean_flat(a, b):
    """Compute Euclidean distance between two flattened arrays."""
    # a = np.ravel(a)
    # b = np.ravel(b)
    return np.linalg.norm(a - b)
```

``` python
Z = get_Z(feature,func_flat=euclidean_flat)
```
